images.name: attack
images.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: production videogame sprite sheet for a six-frame full-body character animation.
Input image: the attached local hero image is the identity, outfit, proportions and line-art reference. Preserve the EXACT recognizable cute anime heroine: small youthful chibi proportions, huge teal eyes, white/lilac side braid with teal bow and yellow flower, white teal gold moon-brooch outfit, white boots, cyan straight sword with circular gold guard. Match reference illustration style; no redesign.
Canvas: 1536 x 1536 pixels, exactly 3 columns x 2 rows of equal invisible cells, each 512 x 768. Exactly SIX poses total, one per cell in row-major sequence. Genuine native TRANSPARENT RGBA background: alpha=0 in all empty space. No opaque white backdrop, no painted checkerboard. No separators, borders, text, numbers, floor, cast shadows, extra objects, particle effects, magic glow, sword trails or motion lines.
Framing: complete full body from top of hair and raised hands/sword to boots entirely within each cell with margins. Stable orthographic camera and constant scale, pelvis at same horizontal anchor in every cell, feet share a consistent baseline. Hero faces right in three-quarter view, enemies are to right. Each pose has exactly two anatomically correct arms and two hands. One sword held consistently by the same sword hand in ALL six frames, no duplicate weapons. Cloth/braid movement can lag naturally.
Animation requirement: truly distinct sequential bodily poses with moving joints; NOT repeated static characters moved or tilted. Frame 1 and frame 6 return to the original reference's relaxed ready stance, sword down diagonally across body toward lower right and free hand loosely open. Preserve identity, scale and clothing through every pose.
Action: ATTACK. Six frames in row-major order: (1) reference ready stance, cyan sword diagonally down toward right; (2) anticipation: knees flex, sword arm lifts back behind shoulder with bent elbow and torso twists slightly away from target; (3) peak attack: small step toward right, torso rotates forward, sword arm extends to slash forward across the body toward right; (4) follow-through: sword finishes diagonally down across body toward right, shoulder and torso follow blade, braid/cape lag behind; (5) recovery: weight shifts back to original stance, elbow lowers and sword settles; (6) identical original ready pose. Blade remains within its own cell at every instant. Generate the actual six-frame movement and no VFX.
images.status: native-alpha output verified; atlas normalization left to parent

edits.prompt: Use case: background-extraction. This input is the EDIT TARGET, an existing six-pose 3-column x 2-row sprite sheet. Remove ONLY the gray-and-white checkerboard background. Return an actual transparent PNG with a real alpha channel; background pixels must have alpha zero. The checkerboard is unwanted image content to remove, NOT a transparency visualization to reproduce. Preserve every colored character pixel and every opaque white part of hair, clothing, boots and sword, including clean antialiased edges. Preserve all six pose drawings, exact character identity, every arm, hand, sword, braid, clothing detail, each pose's location, scale, camera, full-body framing, cell boundaries, and original 1254x1254 canvas geometry. No drawing changes. No rearranging, cropping, resizing or adding margins. Native transparency only: no opaque backdrop, no checkerboard, no new marks, no shadows. This is a clean background extraction of the supplied image into genuine RGBA transparency.

notes: Poses preserved through extraction; equal-cell alignment needs normalization.
Fine fringe pixels may remain around edges.
